evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of fatigue in the setting of a strong family history of
early heart disease.

Findings: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 81 bpm. Normal axis.
PR interval 180 ms, QRS 95 ms, QTc 440 ms.
Impression: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes and no acute changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
45%. Mild left atrial enlargement. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Mildly reduced left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 174 mg/dL
LDL Cholesterol: 86 mg/dL
HDL Cholesterol: 40 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 243 mg/dL (H)

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 135 mmol/L
Potassium: 4.3 mmol/L
Chloride: 98 mmol/L
CO2: 26 mmol/L
BUN: 28 mg/dL (H)
Creatinine: 1.4 mg/dL (H)
Glucose: 155 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 10.0 mg/dL

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Levothyroxine 75 mcg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no carotid bruits.
Carrdiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs or gallops.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.

EXAM:
General: alert, no acute distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: no peripheral edema.
